milestone: FIRST STDIN-DRIVEN FIXTURES IN CLAUSE 13, and the largest single haul of frozen-LFortran defects in one packet so far: nine.

why_this_target.mechanism: List-directed INPUT is driven through run.stdin_file, which tests/fixtures/stop_io/ already proved but which almost nothing in the suite used. The oracle is entirely internal: the program reads a fixed record set and asserts the resulting variable values, so nothing depends on output formatting, which for list-directed output is deliberately processor dependent.
why_this_target.why_input_and_not_output: 13.10.4 leaves list-directed OUTPUT form largely to the processor. Input is where the standard states exact obligations, so input is where portable oracles exist. The packet asserts no list-directed output form.

independent_review.coordinator_question_answered: Whether the nine failures were independent defects or one root cause. They are neither nine unrelated bugs nor a single one: they cluster into three areas of incomplete list-directed handling - repeat counts (r*c and r*), null values, and slash termination. Each required result is independently supported by the pinned text, so each is XFAILed on its own normative basis rather than as one lumped defect.

source_rules_independently_confirmed: 13.10.2 p2: the r*c form is equivalent to r successive appearances of the constant c
13.10.2 p2: the r* form is equivalent to r successive appearances of the null value
13.10.3.1 p2: otherwise c is interpreted as a literal constant
13.10.3.1 p2: if the first effective item is character and the character after r* is nonblank and not a quote, c is an undelimited character constant
13.10.3.1 p9: a character value shorter than the list item is blank padded
13.10.3.2 p1: a null value is specified by no characters between consecutive value separators, by no characters before the first value separator in the first record, or by the r* form
13.10.3.2 p2: a null value has no effect on the definition status of the corresponding list item
13.10.3.2 p3: a slash terminates the data transfer after the transference of the previous value, and any characters remaining in the record are ignored
oracles_hand_derived_and_confirmed: record end acts as a value separator (blank)
multiple blanks collapse to one separator
delimited character constants protect embedded comma, slash and semicolon
'AB' into character(len=4) becomes 'AB' followed by two blanks
5,2*7,19 with a non-character first effective item makes 7 a literal constant repeated twice
2*ab with a character first effective item makes ab an undelimited character constant repeated twice
10,,30 leaves the second item at its prior value
leading comma in the first record leaves the first item at its prior value
1* and 2* leave the corresponding items at their prior values
1 / 99 transfers 1 and leaves the second item at its sentinel -802

non_vacuity.sentinel_audit: Exhaustive. No numeric sentinel is 0, because uninitialized memory is commonly zero and a zero sentinel cannot distinguish 'null value correctly left the item alone' from 'the item was never defined'. The only .false. sentinel is not used for an unchanged/null proof; that case reads .TRUE. Every character case asserts LEN, because character comparison blank-pads the shorter operand.
non_vacuity.positive_state_established_first: Every null-value and slash case defines the item to a distinguished value BEFORE the read, so 'unchanged' is a positive observation rather than the absence of one.
non_vacuity.reverse_controls: All five reverse controls pass under gfortran when weakened to zero, confirming they are load-bearing rather than incidentally true.
non_vacuity.feature_mutation: Value reorder, repeat-count change (3*7 -> 2*7), slash deletion, and separator changes all fail as intended, including on the cases that pass under frozen LFortran.

clusters: repeat counts: r*c and r* forms
null values: empty between separators, leading empty in first record, and the r* null form
lfortran_defects_recorded.note: gfortran 16.1.0 with -std=f2023 passes 18/18. The frozen LFortran 0.65.0-411 target fails exactly these nine, reproduced by the coordinator before recording. Each is a genuine defect against a stated obligation, not a shared malformed test construct: the nine span three independent normative areas and the other nine cases in the same packet, built by the same generator with the same harness, pass.

limitations: Reference validation is gfortran 16.1.0 in f2023 mode on one platform. No universal-processor claim is made.
The packet asserts nothing about list-directed OUTPUT form, which 13.10.4 leaves largely processor dependent.
XFAILs remain failures and take no qualified-pass or facet-completion credit.
